# Audioengine EU

> European distributor of premium Audioengine powered speakers, wireless audio systems, and hi-fi components for home and portable listening.

Audioengine EU specializes in high-quality audio products including powered speaker systems, subwoofers, wireless adapters, and DACs with Bluetooth aptX connectivity. The site serves as the primary catalog and shopping destination for Audioengine products across Europe.

- Audioengine
- Powered Speakers
- Bluetooth Audio
- aptX-HD
- Home Music Systems

- Wireless Audio
- A5+ Home Music System

- Desktop Speakers
- Subwoofers

- Speaker Stands
- Hi-Fi Components
